claims.text: The trip deviated, and the deviation is established under POL-RD-01 on the trace figure, which governs. The trace records 9.56 km between the recorded pickup event and the recorded dropoff event; the platform optimal stored on the trip record at booking is 7.4 km. Excess = 2.16 km and 29.19% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trip record's actual_distance_km of 9.6 is the rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and is deliberately not relied on for the threshold test.

The excess stands on the trace alone. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 130 fixes at a 10-second cadence, no gap between consecutive fixes above 10 seconds, the largest straight-line step between consecutive fixes 122.3 m, and the highest implied speed 44.0 km/h. None of limbs (a), (b) or (c) of POL-RD-07 is met, so no independent corroboration is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

No external-traffic exoneration is available to reduce this excess. The only traffic-advisory artifact in the bundle is EV-ADVIS-04001-01, which is MISSING: it has no payload and carries weight 0.0. There is accordingly no advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle reaching that segment, matched by a route leaving and re-joining the optimal corridor, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. The driver's statement does not assert a traffic cause at all; had one been asserted, POL-RD-13 would discard it for want of the advisory record.

The chat log is IMPAIRED: weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-04001-002 mixes Malay 'singgah' and 'kejap' with English), and I disclose that discount. What it shows is a request for a stop, not a request for a route: 'later can singgah Jurong Point kejap? need to collect parcel at the POPStation, 3 min only', answered by the driver 'ok can, I drop you at the taxi stand side'. Under POL-RD-04 only the excess distance between leaving and re-joining the optimal corridor is excluded; the rider never authorised 2.16 km of additional driving, and the driver's account of what happened cites no evidence ID in his statement, so under POL-RD-08 that assertion carries no weight and is discarded.

The quantum of any POL-RD-04 exclusion is not on this record and must not be invented. The waypoint_approach block reports only the nearest fix to the requested waypoint — 49.8 m, at 10:18:02 — and nothing in the bundle identifies where the vehicle left the optimal corridor or where it re-joined it. With no measured leave-and-rejoin stretch, the excess cannot be adjusted down on the evidence as it stands, and the figure that governs POL-RD-02 remains the measured 2.16 km against the booked optimal of 7.4 km.

The refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. The fare model on the fare breakdown is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs (not POL-RD-11), and the surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, which is 1.0. Recomputed fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.4 + 0.28 x 15) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharge - 0 promo discount = 13.55 + 0.80 = 14.35. Charged total is 17.65, so the refund is 17.65 - 14.35 = 3.30. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so the outcome is not NO_ACTION) and is 18.7% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome for the filing rider is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.30, rounded up to the nearest 0.05.

Nothing is added on top of that figure and nothing is double-counted. The fare breakdown's ERP block shows on-optimal-route total 0.00 and off-optimal-route total 0.00 with no gantry lines, there is no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor terminates at an airport), and the waiting-time fee is 0.00, so the POL-RD-09 pass-through correction is nil and the distance-and-time refund of 3.30 stands alone as the entire monetary correction.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and the case can be ruled on. The trip identifier matches across the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown; the timestamps are consistent and causally ordered, with the trace's first fix equal to started_at 10:12:40 and its last fix equal to ended_at 10:33:55; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c); every charge line has a counterpart on the record; and the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total.

Confidence is not capped below the platform floor. The artifacts that carry the deciding facts — the trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not reached; the only impaired artifact on the bundle is the chat log at 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, and it does not carry the deciding fact of the measured excess.

The detour the rider now disputes is one the rider herself ordered. MSG-04001-002 in EV-CHAT-04001 was sent by the RIDER at 10:11:40 and reads 'uncle later can singgah Jurong Point kejap? need to collect parcel at the POPStation, 3 min only'; it carries waypoint_hint Jurong Point (1.33975, 103.7064), which the platform itself resolved from the message text at ingest. That satisfies POL-RD-04(a), the instruction comes from the rider, and POL-RD-04(c), it identifies a place specifically enough to act on. It is not one of the vague messages the clause excludes. EV-CHAT-04001 is impaired and I disclose it rather than present it as clean: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, because MSG-04001-002 mixes Malay ('singgah', 'kejap') with English. Even at that discount the artifact sits well above the platform's 0.70 confidence floor, and the driver's acceptance, MSG-04001-003, is in plain English.

The instruction came before the vehicle left the optimal corridor, which is what POL-RD-04(b) requires. MSG-04001-002 was sent at 10:11:40; the trip did not start until 10:12:40, when the rider came on board (EV-TRIP-04001, trip_started event); and even the driver's assent, MSG-04001-003, was sent at 10:12:00, still before departure. The vehicle therefore left the corridor on the rider's instruction and not on the driver's own initiative. (EV-CHAT-04001 carries the impairment disclosed above: IMPAIRED, weight 0.85, LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY.)

POL-RD-04's corroboration test is satisfied on the platform's own computation. Fix 33 of EV-GPS-04001, at 10:18:02, lies 49.83 m from the requested waypoint - well inside the clause's 200 m threshold - so the vehicle did pass within 200 m of the place the rider named, exactly as POL-RD-04 demands. The geometry comes from EV-GPS-04001, a COMPLETE artifact at weight 1.0 (130 fixes, 10 s cadence, no gaps); the instruction it corroborates comes from EV-CHAT-04001, impaired at 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, which I disclose.

The stop actually happened, and the rider's own messages say so. She asked for three minutes (MSG-04001-002), and at 10:20:45 she sent MSG-04001-004: 'ok got it, coming back to the car now'. That sentence only makes sense if she had left the vehicle at the requested stop and was returning to it. The driver's account - he waited at the taxi stand about three minutes and then drove on to Bukit Batok - matches both the chat and the trace. (EV-CHAT-04001 is impaired: IMPAIRED, weight 0.85, LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY.)

Because the detour was rider-requested and corroborated, POL-RD-04 excludes the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor 'before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied', and on this record that is the whole of the measured excess. The platform's own derived deviation is 2.16 km, or 29.19%, against the 7.4 km booked optimal - above the 0.8 km and 20% establishment gates of POL-RD-01 but far below its 8.0 km and 50% materiality gates, so POL-RD-06 never engages. The rider's own narrative describes a single loop ('one big round'), the only stop the record contains is the Jurong Point waypoint the trace approaches, and nothing in the evidence identifies any second departure from the corridor. Exclude that excess and no deviation survives POL-RD-01, no refund arithmetic under POL-RD-02 is reached, and the rider's claim fails.

POL-RD-08 shifts the burden to the driver once the rider shows a threshold excess, and the driver discharges it in exactly the way that clause requires: by pointing to a specific artifact and a specific clause. The artifact is EV-CHAT-04001, message MSG-04001-002, the rider's request with its platform-resolved waypoint_hint, corroborated by the waypoint-approach computation in EV-GPS-04001; the clause is POL-RD-04. This is not the bare 'traffic was bad' assertion POL-RD-08 refuses to entertain. It is rider causation, evidenced by the rider's own message and by the trace's approach to the point she named.

No repeat-deviation pattern may be found against this driver on the fields POL-RD-06 names. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, against a trigger of 3 flags, and 0 flags over 260 completed_trips_90d is a ratio of 0 against a trigger of 0.05, with completed_trips_90d of 260 well above the clause's 40-trip minimum. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field and is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for; POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it. POL-RD-06 is in any event not engaged on materiality, because the excess of 2.16 km is under both the 8.0 km and the 50% materiality gates of POL-RD-01.

There is no billing defect to correct and no bad faith to hold against the driver. EV-FARE-04001 reconciles to the cent: 3.80 base fare + 7.17 distance on 9.56 km + 5.88 time on 21 min + 0.80 platform fee = 17.65. distance_charged_km 9.56 equals the trace distance of 9.56, so no distance went unbilled and none was inflated; there are no ERP or toll lines and no gantry the trace never crossed; and waiting_time_fee is 0.00, so the driver did not bill the rider a cent for the three minutes she asked him to wait. Nothing on the fare artifact supports a pass-through or billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09.

No mandatory escalation trigger under POL-RD-10 is engaged. The gps_trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 130 fixes at a 10 s cadence, a largest interval of 10 s against a 90 s limit, and a largest straight-line step of 122.3 m against a 500 m limit, so POL-RD-10(3) has no purchase and the measured excess and the corroboration both rest on an ungapped trace. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-04001-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 because no advisory was retrieved for this trip, and that absence costs the driver nothing: he asserts no external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is neither invoked nor needed, and POL-RD-13 confirms that an advisory cited by no party as an exculpatory record is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes.

The present state is a charge that stands: EV-FARE-04001 records payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a rider-filed dispute over this fare, NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 leaves that state exactly as it is, so the metered fare remains with the driver who earned it. Since the deviation is exonerated under POL-RD-04, no billing-integrity defect exists under POL-RD-09, and no escalation trigger fires, that is the outcome this record supports.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This was a metered RYDE_X trip on 22 Aug 2026 from Pioneer MRT to Bukit Batok West Ave 6. The booking estimate on the trip record (EV-TRIP-04001) was 7.4 km; the GPS trace (EV-GPS-04001), which governs over the rounded 9.6 km copy on the trip record, measures 9.56 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events. Excess = 9.56 - 7.4 = 2.16 km, or 29.19% of the booked route. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so a deviation is established; it is below the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gates, so no POL-RD-06 pattern check or conduct referral arises (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 260 completed_trips_90d). prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context-only and I have not used it.

On the driver's main point: you are right that the rider asked for the Jurong Point stop. Chat message MSG-04001-002 (EV-CHAT-04001) was sent by the rider at 10:11:40, with the platform-resolved waypoint Jurong Point, and the trace shows the vehicle 49.83 m from that waypoint at 10:18:02 - inside POL-RD-04's 200 m corroboration threshold. That is why no finding of bad faith is made against you. But POL-RD-04 excludes only 'the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor', and this record does not identify that stretch: the waypoint-approach computation gives only the nearest fix, and nothing in the bundle shows where the vehicle left the booked corridor or where it rejoined it. I may not invent that figure, and your own account (a three-minute stop, then straight to Bukit Batok) does not show that 2.16 km of extra driving was rider-caused; the rider asked for a brief stop, not a 2.16 km detour. The argument that the whole measured excess is the excluded stretch was not accepted. So the measured excess stands.

The chat log EV-CHAT-04001 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (MSG-04001-002 mixes Malay and English). It is disclosed here as POL-GEN-02(3) requires; the excess finding does not rest on it, so the discount does not change this ruling. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (130 fixes, 10 s cadence, largest gap 10 s, largest step 122.3 m).

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs (not POL-RD-11). The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (1.0). Recomputed fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.4 + 0.28 x 15) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 14.35. Charged total = 17.65. Refund = 17.65 - 14.35 = 3.30, above the 0.50 de minimis and well below 90% of the charge, so the outcome is a partial refund. Rounded up to the nearest 0.05 it is SGD 3.30, and the balance of the metered fare remains with the driver.

Nothing is added on top: EV-FARE-04001 shows no ERP or toll lines (on- and off-optimal-route totals both 0.00), no airport surcharge, and waiting_time_fee 0.00, so there is no POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction and none is double-counted. POL-RD-04's compensation limb does not apply either: distance_charged_km (9.56) equals the trace distance, so there is no unbilled distance to compensate.

No escalation trigger fires under POL-RD-10: the trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the timestamps are causally ordered; the trace is unimpaired; every charge line has a counterpart on the record; and the refund is far below SGD 150.00. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-04001-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT); no party asserts a traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 was never invoked and, under POL-RD-13, that absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction. The monetary effect (SGD 3.30) is below the execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and may be executed automatically. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

This ruling is addressed to both of you. It concerns trip TRP-04001, Pioneer MRT Station to Bukit Batok West Ave 6 on 22 Aug 2026.

On the measured evidence a route deviation is established. I do not award it, because POL-RD-04 exonerates the excess. The rider herself asked for the detour. Her message MSG-04001-002 in EV-CHAT-04001, sent at 10:11:40 before the vehicle moved (the trip started at 10:12:40), asks the driver to stop at Jurong Point to collect a parcel and carries the platform-resolved waypoint_hint that POL-RD-04 requires; the driver agreed at 10:12:00; and the trace corroborates it, fix 33 at 10:18:02 lying 49.8 m from the waypoint, inside the clause's 200 m threshold. The artifacts that carry the deciding facts — the trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not reached; the only impaired artifact on the bundle is the chat log at 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, and it does not carry the deciding fact of the measured excess.

The detour the rider now disputes is one the rider herself ordered. MSG-04001-002 in EV-CHAT-04001 was sent by the RIDER at 10:11:40 and reads 'uncle later can singgah Jurong Point kejap? need to collect parcel at the POPStation, 3 min only'; it carries waypoint_hint Jurong Point (1.33975, 103.7064), which the platform itself resolved from the message text at ingest. That satisfies POL-RD-04(a), the instruction comes from the rider, and POL-RD-04(c), it identifies a place specifically enough to act on. It is not one of the vague messages the clause excludes. EV-CHAT-04001 is impaired and I disclose it rather than present it as clean: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, because MSG-04001-002 mixes Malay ('singgah', 'kejap') with English. Even at that discount the artifact sits well above the platform's 0.70 confidence floor, and the driver's acceptance, MSG-04001-003, is in plain English.

The instruction came before the vehicle left the optimal corridor, which is what POL-RD-04(b) requires. MSG-04001-002 was sent at 10:11:40; the trip did not start until 10:12:40, when the rider came on board (EV-TRIP-04001, trip_started event); and even the driver's assent, MSG-04001-003, was sent at 10:12:00, still before departure. The vehicle therefore left the corridor on the rider's instruction and not on the driver's own initiative. (EV-CHAT-04001 carries the impairment disclosed above: IMPAIRED, weight 0.85, LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY.)

POL-RD-04's corroboration test is satisfied on the platform's own computation. Fix 33 of EV-GPS-04001, at 10:18:02, lies 49.83 m from the requested waypoint - well inside the clause's 200 m threshold - so the vehicle did pass within 200 m of the place the rider named, exactly as POL-RD-04 demands. The geometry comes from EV-GPS-04001, a COMPLETE artifact at weight 1.0 (130 fixes, 10 s cadence, no gaps); the instruction it corroborates comes from EV-CHAT-04001, impaired at 0.85 for LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY, which I disclose.

The stop actually happened, and the rider's own messages say so. She asked for three minutes (MSG-04001-002), and at 10:20:45 she sent MSG-04001-004: 'ok got it, coming back to the car now'. That sentence only makes sense if she had left the vehicle at the requested stop and was returning to it. The driver's account - he waited at the taxi stand about three minutes and then drove on to Bukit Batok - matches both the chat and the trace. (EV-CHAT-04001 is impaired: IMPAIRED, weight 0.85, LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY.)

Because the detour was rider-requested and corroborated, POL-RD-04 excludes the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor 'before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied', and on this record that is the whole of the measured excess. The platform's own derived deviation is 2.16 km, or 29.19%, against the 7.4 km booked optimal - above the 0.8 km and 20% establishment gates of POL-RD-01 but far below its 8.0 km and 50% materiality gates, so POL-RD-06 never engages. The rider's own narrative describes a single loop ('one big round'), the only stop the record contains is the Jurong Point waypoint the trace approaches, and nothing in the evidence identifies any second departure from the corridor. Exclude that excess and no deviation survives POL-RD-01, no refund arithmetic under POL-RD-02 is reached, and the rider's claim fails.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-CHAT-04001 at weight_multiplier 0.85 but does not name its issue code(s): LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY

ledger.claim: POL-RD-08 shifts the burden to the driver once the rider shows a threshold excess, and the driver discharges it in exactly the way that clause requires: by pointing to a specific artifact and a specific clause. The artifact is EV-CHAT-04001, message MSG-04001-002, the rider's request with its platform-resolved waypoint_hint, corroborated by the waypoint-approach computation in EV-GPS-04001; the clause is POL-RD-04. This is not the bare 'traffic was bad' assertion POL-RD-08 refuses to entertain. It is rider causation, evidenced by the rider's own message and by the trace's approach to the point she named.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-CHAT-04001 at weight_multiplier 0.85 but does not name its issue code(s): LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY

ledger.claim: No repeat-deviation pattern may be found against this driver on the fields POL-RD-06 names. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, against a trigger of 3 flags, and 0 flags over 260 completed_trips_90d is a ratio of 0 against a trigger of 0.05, with completed_trips_90d of 260 well above the clause's 40-trip minimum. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field and is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for; POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it. POL-RD-06 is in any event not engaged on materiality, because the excess of 2.16 km is under both the 8.0 km and the 50% materiality gates of POL-RD-01.
flags: context-only profile field mentioned in claim text: prior_deviation_flags

ledger.claim: There is no billing defect to correct and no bad faith to hold against the driver. EV-FARE-04001 reconciles to the cent: 3.80 base fare + 7.17 distance on 9.56 km + 5.88 time on 21 min + 0.80 platform fee = 17.65. distance_charged_km 9.56 equals the trace distance of 9.56, so no distance went unbilled and none was inflated; there are no ERP or toll lines and no gantry the trace never crossed; and waiting_time_fee is 0.00, so the driver did not bill the rider a cent for the three minutes she asked him to wait. Nothing on the fare artifact supports a pass-through or billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09.

No mandatory escalation trigger under POL-RD-10 is engaged. The gps_trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 130 fixes at a 10 s cadence, a largest interval of 10 s against a 90 s limit, and a largest straight-line step of 122.3 m against a 500 m limit, so POL-RD-10(3) has no purchase and the measured excess and the corroboration both rest on an ungapped trace. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-04001-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 because no advisory was retrieved for this trip, and that absence costs the driver nothing: he asserts no external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is neither invoked nor needed, and POL-RD-13 confirms that an advisory cited by no party as an exculpatory record is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-04001-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ledger.claim: The present state is a charge that stands: EV-FARE-04001 records payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On a rider-filed dispute over this fare, NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 leaves that state exactly as it is, so the metered fare remains with the driver who earned it. Since the deviation is exonerated under POL-RD-04, no billing-integrity defect exists under POL-RD-09, and no escalation trigger fires, that is the outcome this record supports.
